meta.name: ultrawork
meta.description: The binding ultrawork-mode directive. This file IS the directive; read it only when ultrawork mode is requested and the directive is not already in the conversation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按预设规则切换助手的工作模式,让它照你设定的方式执行任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让助手用一套固定指令改变自己的工作方式
copy.tagline_en: Switch the assistant into a preset work mode so it runs tasks your way
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want the assistant to change how it works via a fixed set of directives

howto.what: 进入 ultrawork 模式后，Claude 会先输出「ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!」，再登记目标与验收标准、开追加式记事本、写计划与待办，只交付能用真实渠道证据（curl、浏览器等）证实的成果。
howto.when: 当你请求进入 ultrawork 模式、且当前对话里还没有这份指令时触发。

say.text: 用 ultrawork 模式帮我修这个 bug

say.text: ultrawork 模式，给这个接口加一条校验规则
say.note: 按 LIGHT 档，产出一条真实渠道证据

say.text: ultrawork 模式，先设计再改这个模块
say.note: 提到先设计，按 HEAVY 档处理

howto.what_en: Ultrawork mode makes Claude print `ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!` first, then bootstrap: register a goal with success criteria, open an append-only notepad, write the plan to a file and register todos. It ships evidence-backed work.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you request ultrawork mode and the directive is not already in the conversation.

say_en.text: Fix this bug in ultrawork mode
say_en.note: Prints the banner, then registers goal and evidence checks.

say_en.text: Add a validation rule to this endpoint in ultrawork mode
say_en.note: Runs the LIGHT tier with one real-surface proof.

say_en.text: Redesign this module in ultrawork mode
say_en.note: Signals care, so it takes the HEAVY tier.
